body: This PR is a follow-up to https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/59645. For more context, check out the details in that PR. It applies the same fix to the persistent path: `persistent_topk`, and its filtered kernel (>32 rows). ## Test Result `test_top_k_per_row.py` on B300: 526 passed, including 159 candidate-overflow cases. Main is not exact on 51/96 overflow configs; the PR is exact on all of them. # Results
title: [2/N][Bugfix] Make persistent TopK exact on candidate overflow
